# Azure SQL Developer Hub

> Azure SQL Developer Hub: three featured cloud-first application prompt drafts, portal setup guidance and optional skills resources. Engineering validation is pending. Earlier scenario pages remain available for review. Replace `.html` with `.md` for a page's Markdown twin; the homepage is `/index.md`.

For the whole site as one document, read {{ '/llms-full.txt' | absolute_url }}.

## Pages
- [Home]({{ '/index.md' | absolute_url }}): quickstart commands for the agent, local container, and Azure CLI paths; the six build scenarios; featured prompts; per-agent skill install commands.
- [Start a database]({{ '/build/start-database.md' | absolute_url }}): container verification with sqlcmd, plus the Azure free offer portal path.
- [Connect your app]({{ '/build/connect-app.md' | absolute_url }}): connection-string configuration and a parameterized query with the current driver.
- [Wire up RAG]({{ '/build/rag.md' | absolute_url }}): vector column schema and cosine similarity search with VECTOR_DISTANCE.
- [Multi-tenant setup]({{ '/build/multi-tenant.md' | absolute_url }}): Row-Level Security with a SESSION_CONTEXT predicate and security policy.
- [Fix a slow query]({{ '/build/query-performance.md' | absolute_url }}): capture IO and timing statistics, then tune from evidence.
- [Ship local to cloud]({{ '/build/local-to-cloud.md' | absolute_url }}): move the app from the local engine to Azure SQL Database through configuration.
- [Prompt library]({{ '/prompts.md' | absolute_url }}): copyable build prompts, plus the container repository's prompt catalog.

## Key facts
- Local: the Azure SQL Database container image is `sqldbpreview-dpgaeqhmgphzd4bk.azurecr.io/azure-sql/db-dev`, x64 (linux/amd64). On a host that is not x64, add `--platform linux/amd64`. The registry is private during the Private Preview; credentials come from signing up at https://aka.ms/sqldbcontainerpreview-signup.
- Cloud: the Azure SQL Database free offer gives 100,000 vCore seconds of serverless compute, 32 GB of data, and 32 GB of backup storage per database per month, for up to 10 databases per Azure subscription. It needs an Azure account and subscription. The CLI path is `az sql db create ... --use-free-limit --free-limit-exhaustion-behavior AutoPause`.
- Agent: 17 agent skills install with `npx skills add microsoft/azure-sql-database-container` in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and VS Code with GitHub Copilot. Claude Code and Codex can also install them as a native plugin with `/plugin marketplace add microsoft/azure-sql-database-container`.
- AI-native: native vector data type, VECTOR_DISTANCE similarity search, and in-database embeddings. Exact top-k search is recommended up to roughly 50,000 candidate vectors; DiskANN vector indexes for approximate search are in preview.
- Connection: TCP port 1433, SQL login (sa) locally, Microsoft Entra in the cloud. Moving from the local container to Azure SQL Database in the cloud is a connection-string change, not a code change.
- MCP: an Azure SQL MCP endpoint is not published yet. The skills optionally use the public Microsoft Learn MCP (https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp) as a live documentation layer.

## Status
- The Azure SQL Database container is in Private Preview.
- This site is in active development.
